niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with clear structure, readable hierarchy, and restrained styling. This user repeatedly favors visible navigation, segmented card-based layouts, balanced contrast, and either dark immersive backgrounds with clear separation or light neutral surfaces with soft fills. They prefer concise copy, simpler visual metaphors, minimal ornamentation, and straightforward data presentation over flashy, decorative, or overly dense designs. They also show repeated preference for soft purple/lavender accents and cool-toned backgrounds over warmer pink/red or teal treatments.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong hierarchy with prominent titles, centered or clearly emphasized primary information, distinct sectioning, and obvious grouping rather than weak hierarchy or undifferentiated content blocks.
Prefers modular, separated cards and stacked sections with crisp boundaries instead of monolithic panels or continuous embedded layouts.
Prefers layouts that avoid crowding and preserve breathing room, while still maintaining useful structure and content presence rather than being either overly sparse or overly packed.

Prefers visible navigation chrome and framed headers, including top app bars, back/overflow controls, active navigation states, and cohesive header controls rather than missing or weak navigation structure.

Prefers calm, understated, minimally decorative interfaces with simple controls, plain labeling, and limited ornamental effects instead of flashy, glowing, gamified, or overly embellished presentation.

Prefers strong readability through balanced contrast and clear surface separation, such as dimmed backdrops, light cards on dark backgrounds, filled inputs, and distinct panels rather than washed-out, low-separation, or dark-on-dark treatments.
Prefers cool-toned palettes, especially dark blue gradients, gray-lavender backgrounds, and soft purple accents, over warmer pink/red tones, teal accents, or flat near-black backgrounds.
